card.name: Enzyme-deficiency drug label dosing text
card.fires_on: Small linking words (with, for, an opening parenthesis, a space after Table) and partway points in names such as sapropterin, in labels for enzyme-related metabolic disorders (PKU, Fabry disease, HGPRT deficiency). The next word is often a drug or disease name.

modes.label: Linking words before treatment or disease
modes.description: Words like with or for right before a drug name or a metabolic disease.

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: Partway through names like sapropterin or PALYNZIQ.
